mission.objective: Add research-only standing_authorization_grant and scheduled_wake_record candidate shapes to the shadow schema candidates, extend revocation_request with grant_id, and register the standing-authorization lane as V3-ANCHOR-009, without approving any scheduled, unattended, or ambient execution.

envelope.not_created_reason: Bounded docs-only change executed from a direct thread-local sponsor instruction; this shadow record was authored during the mission.

forbidden_scope: no scheduled, unattended, or ambient execution approval
no scheduler, cron, or live-messaging wiring
allowed_commands: scoped git add, commit, and push after approval
fallback_triggers: scope expands beyond prose candidate shapes and the registry row
any wording implies scheduled execution, unattended work, or live integration is approved
a candidate shape becomes a machine-readable schema file

verification.summary: Advisory lint, NL pilot, knowledge lint, and diff whitespace checks passed on the first run after the edits; mission-record lint run after this record was authored.

notes: Docs-only prose candidates with no new dependencies, schema files, or code paths.
Both new candidate shapes carry explicit research-vocabulary-only boundaries and state that per-mission human Go remains the only approved authorization shape.
The anchor row uses none_yet evidence paths because no standing-grant evidence exists.
Scope stayed inside the shadow schema doc, registry row, and README scope bullet.
No scheduled execution, scheduler wiring, credential, or live-integration scope was added.

friction_notes: The naming deliberately uses standing_authorization rather than standing_authority, following the MR_20260610_008 lesson where authority-flavored wording drew an accepted NL-pilot finding.
Vendor scheduled-run capability is announcement-grade external signal; the lane has no local evidence and the anchor row records that honestly with none_yet.
false_positive_notes: No advisory findings were raised on this change.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: A standing grant differs from a mission envelope mainly by expiry, renewal, suspension, and async escalation; modeling it as a separate shape avoids overloading the envelope.
Tying each unattended wake to a wake record that references its grant keeps the one-mission-one-record replay property under future scheduled operation.
Extending revocation_request with grant_id was cheaper than inventing a separate grant-revocation shape.
